title: Finite colimits of the normalized right extensions
statement: Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite extension, $T$ a scheme, $A$ the abelian data of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and $R$ any normalized family of right extensions as specified in [lem-sp-tower-normalized-right-adjoints]. For every nonnegative index $n$, the functor from level-$n+1$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to coefficient towers, obtained from $R_n$ by the inverse of the strict-system equivalence, preserves finite colimits.

proof.text: At an upper level scalar restriction preserves cokernels and finite biproducts, since it leaves underlying abelian sheaves unchanged and cokernels are sheafified sectionwise. This is systemScalarRestriction_exact in the stated system-level interface. At a lower level the zero functor preserves these colimits.

The normalized upper objects and maps give equality of the evaluated extension functor with scalar restriction, by Functor.hext. At lower levels every object is zero, so the evaluated functor preserves colimits. A componentwise inverse to a strict-system map with invertible components commutes with transitions by cancellation, so the family of strict evaluations jointly reflects isomorphisms. Since evaluations preserve finite colimits, jointlyReflectsColimit detects the mapped finite colimit cocone. Transport through the equivalence preserves finite colimits.

proof_origin.place: Exactness; implemented by Z5 using levelwise scalar restriction, jointly conservative exact evaluations, and transport through the equivalence.

3 hits: Adjunction.map_injective, Injective.injective_of_adjoint and Adjunction.injective_of_map_injective. These give the injective consequence, not the right extension construction.

Evaluation adjunctions in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Evaluation are for a fixed target category; none gives the prescribed varying-ring functor. Local rg also found systemScalarRestriction_exact in SystemLevelLeftExtension.

theorem sp_tower_right_extension_finite_colimits (A : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E T)
    (R : SpTowerRightAdjoints l E T A) (n : ℕ) :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (R.right n ⋙ A.equivalence.inverse)
